FASTVC-BENCH-CORPUS:chromium-main-v1-943b94ae-1c74-4335-94fa-ceb4d277cea8
Verifies that external change of inline style element updates its title.

=== initial inline style text ===
<style id=​"inline-style">​
          div { color: red }
      ​</style>​
=== inline style text after change ===
<style id=​"inline-style">​span { border: 1px solid black }​</style>​
